core_definition_en: using a particular language
example_en: Please write your answer in English.
usage_note_zh: Don't use *with English* for the language of an answer.
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: in relation to or concerning a person or thing
example_en: Her attitude toward change is positive.
usage_note_zh: toward 在此不是物理方向
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: before the end of a specified period
example_en: We'll reply within three working days.
example_zh: 我们将在三个工作日内答复。
usage_note_zh: within three days 表示三天之内，并非恰好三天后
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_zh: 直到某事发生才做另一件事
core_definition_en: not before a specified event occurs
example_en: I didn't understand it until she explained it.
example_zh: 直到她解释后我才明白。
usage_note_zh: not until 对时间界限进行强调
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: in or at the place in which
example_en: Leave the keys where you found them.
example_zh: 把钥匙放回你找到它们的地方。
usage_note_zh: 在地点状语从句中 where 不要求先行词
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: for each unit of a specified quantity
example_en: The fee is twenty dollars per person.
usage_note_zh: per person 相当于 for each person，常见于价格和比率
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: following the length of something
example_en: We cycled along the river.
usage_note_zh: along 强调沿线移动，不等同于 across
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: approaching in time
example_en: We hope to launch in the near future.
example_zh: 我们希望在不久的将来推出。
usage_note_zh: near future 为常用固定搭配
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: in the middle of a group
example_en: She felt relaxed among friends.
example_zh: 在朋友们中间她感到放松。
usage_note_zh: among 常表示置身群体之中
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: people in general, including the speaker
example_en: You never know what will happen.
example_zh: 谁也说不准将会发生什么。
usage_note_zh: 泛指 you 不一定指听话人本人
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: later or less advanced than expected
example_en: The project is two weeks behind schedule.
usage_note_zh: behind schedule 与 ahead of schedule 相对
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: the two members of a pair together
example_en: The course covers both theory and practice.
example_zh: 这门课程涵盖理论和实践。
usage_note_zh: both ... and ... 连接并列成分
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: up to the time when
example_en: Wait till the rain stops.
usage_note_zh: till 与 until 含义接近，语体通常更口语
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_zh: 在数量、等级或标准之上
core_definition_en: higher than a given level or standard
example_en: Applicants must be above eighteen years of age.
example_zh: 申请者必须超过十八岁。
usage_note_zh: above 18 通常为严格大于18，法律年龄要求应按具体文本判断
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: also not; used after a negative statement
example_en: I don't like the noise either.
usage_note_zh: 肯定句的“也”通常用 too/as well
source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_en: which person
example_en: Who did you meet yesterday?

source_attribution: AI original draft; frozen Core20K rank/lemma; no dictionary verification

core_definition_zh: 遍及某一区域或多个群体
core_definition_en: throughout an area or across groups

usage_note_zh: 不是仅表示横穿某个物体

core_definition_en: marking the infinitive of a verb
example_en: She decided to stay.

core_definition_en: whenever a specified situation occurs
